label: Email Reader
description: An open email in a light Gmail-style client: sender row, subject, body, and a marker-sweep highlight over the money quote. The reading verb (email-compose is the writing verb) -- use it when a message ARRIVES and something inside it matters.

body.label: Body
body.description: Email body; paragraphs split on newlines. Mark the money quote with *asterisks* (or use highlight_quote).

highlight_quote.label: Highlight quote
highlight_quote.description: Exact substring of the body to sweep with the marker highlight. Ignored if the body already carries *asterisk* marks or the substring is not found.

script_actions.description: Click a toolbar action or a point in the message
